# HTTP 路徑與狀態碼
/api/
\bHTTP\b
\b(?:GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE)\s+/
\b[1-5]\d\d\s+(?:OK|Created|Bad Request|Unauthorized|Forbidden|Not Found|Conflict|Unprocessable)\b

# 程式結構與框架
\w+(?:UseCase|Controller|Repository|Service|Entity|Dto|DTO|Adapter|Mapper)\b
\b(?:Spring|JPA|Hibernate|ArchUnit|Gradle|Angular|NgRx)\b
@\w+\(

# 資料庫
(?-i:\b(?:SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE FROM)\s+\w+)
\btable\b
資料表
